objective: Compare entity-resolution quality and execution characteristics under one ground-truth corpus without granting any implementation privileged scoring.

training_policy.supervised_systems: May consume only the declared training partition and training labels.
training_policy.unsupervised_systems: May configure/model using only their documented supported workflow and may not consume hidden test truth.

forbidden: dropping difficult records from one challenger only
reporting supervised training time as zero
feeding test ground truth into configuration
